title: Gentle AI SDD edit-authority consent question
description: The typed blocking consent question a multi-repository SDD change raises when its task plan targets repository roots outside the authorized edit roots (#2540). The identity block is the change name plus the missing roots; granting is per-change, audited, and dies with archive; declining persists nothing and the change stays blocked. Native SDD status emits this envelope on blocked(edit_authority_missing) as the optional `consent` block of the v1 status projection (#2563).

choice_granted.description: The exact flag set of the shipped sdd-attempt grant verb (S3 #2558 plus S5 #2559's reconciliation): the conscious contract change the provisional S3 pin announced, applied by #2563 together with the fixture and the test pin. --request-id makes accidental re-execution idempotent, --change-instance binds the grant to the one change instance the status layer derived, and the optional --expected-revision is the compare-and-swap token a widening grant chains on.

choice_declined.description: Declining persists nothing: the change stays blocked, and the runnable follow-up is native SDD status for the same change. The effect text names both remaining exits.
